title: The Temple Workforce
description: King Solomon conscripted forced laborers from all Israel: 30,000 men were sent to Lebanon in shifts—one month in Lebanon and two months at home—under the supervision of Adoniram. In addition, he had 70,000 carriers and 80,000 stonecutters in the hills, as well as 3,300 foremen. By the king's command, large, costly stones were quarried for the foundation of God's house, and Solomon's and Hiram's builders, together with the men from Gebal, cut the stones and prepared the timber for the temple.
